Found it. The definition is in `zstd/contrib/linux-kernel/test/include/asm/cpufeature.h:13`:

```c
#define X86_FEATURE_BMI2 0
#define cpu_feature_enabled(feature) ((void)(feature), 0)
```

This is the stub header zstd ships for building the linux-kernel test harness outside the kernel — it defines the x86 feature macro to a plain zero so `cpu_feature_enabled(X86_FEATURE_BMI2)` compiles to a constant false.
